description: This file defines an interface for capturing screenshots or screen data within the WPEFramework project. It includes a nested interface for storing the captured data and provides methods to retrieve the capture name and perform the capture operation.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ICapture
classes.description: An interface for capturing screen images, including methods to get the capture name, perform capture, and access the nested IStore interface.

classes.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ICapture::IStore
classes.description: An interface for storing captured image data, with a method to process raw pixel buffers in RGBA format.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ICapture::Name
methods.description: Returns the name identifier of the capture interface.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ICapture::Capture
methods.description: Performs a capture operation, storing the result via the provided IStore object.

methods.name: WPEFramework::Exchange::ICapture::Instance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the ICapture interface for performing screen captures.

ctags.name: ICapture
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL ICapture : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
